reason: The Condition 1 combobox has autocomplete="garbage" on both states, a deliberate way to keep browsers from autofilling it. It does not collect personal information, so no AA criterion fails, and the tree still exposes combobox "Condition 1" with its states.
criterionAnalysis: 1.3.5 Identify Input Purpose applies only to fields that collect information about the user and serve a purpose in the WCAG input-purpose list (name, email, address, card number and so on). The Condition 1 combobox picks which transaction field a categorization rule tests, so it has no listed purpose and 1.3.5 cannot fail. No other A or AA criterion covers an autocomplete token: 4.1.2 is met because the field exposes role combobox, name Condition 1 and expanded and haspopup states, and 4.1.1 is no longer in WCAG 2.2.
